evidence.title: Register to fast-track your status
evidence.summary: Eligible members are Aeroplan 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K and Super Elite members, and Aeroplan Premium Credit Cardholders, with accounts linked to World of Hyatt. Members must register by November 30, 2026, and the page says registration is now closed. Aeroplan Elite members may use one such offer per calendar year. Hyatt may alter or withdraw the offer at any time without notice.
